$comment: Lazy runtime parts. Build/Sync-Assets.ps1 assembles each into canopyx-<name>.js (and .css), registers it with CanopyX.registerPart, writes the build manifest every entry point reads, and writes canopyx-parts.json, which CanopyX.Html reads to write and embed the parts. Entry points leave out every script a part lists, unless the part lists it under shared too. features names the view features that make a view load the part (for example pager, editable, rowData, formatting, formatEditor, columnGroups, rangeSelection, grouping, detail, searchHighlight, layout, record), so only the fragments of views that use one carry its payload; CanopyHtmlPart maps each name to the view settings that turn it on. See docs/plugins.md.
